errors.text_span: а дясната показва стотни от 0% до 120%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly uses the word "стотни" (hundredths) to describe the percentage scale on the right y-axis. The scale is simply in percent.
The description fails to mention the labels for the two vertical axes. The left axis is labeled "внос и износ" (import and export) and the right axis is labeled "търговия" (trade).

The description only mentions the striped columns for "внос" (import) and completely omits the existence of the solid gray columns, which represent "износ" (export). The chart clearly shows two sets of bars for each year.
The value for the striped bar ("внос"/import) in 2004 is approximately 55%, not 20%.

errors.text_span: Линията, оцветена в черно, представя обема на търговията и започва от едва над 50% през 2004 г., достига пик малко над 65% през 2008 г., след това намалява до под 50% през 2012 г., и се увеличава до около 60% през 2019 г..
errors.evidence: The description reads the values for the line chart ("Търговия"/trade) against the left y-axis (0-70%) when it corresponds to the right y-axis (0-120%). For example, in 2004, the value is approximately 95%, not "едва над 50%".

errors.text_span: Последната линия, в тъмносив цвят, представя износа
errors.evidence: The chart does not contain a second line representing "износ" (export). Exports are represented by solid gray bars.

errors.text_span: достига пик около 55% през 2008 г., след това намалява до около 30% през 2012 г.,
errors.evidence: This describes the hallucinated line for exports. The actual peak for exports (the solid gray bars) is around 53% in 2013, not 55% in 2008. The value in 2008 is about 41%. The value does not decrease to 30% in 2012; it is around 50% in 2012.

errors.text_span: В долния ляв ъгъл на диаграмата има легенда
errors.evidence: The legend is located at the bottom center of the chart, not in the bottom left corner.
The description of the legend is incomplete. It omits the entry for "износ" (export), which is represented by solid gray bars.
